action.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT g.account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN g.period = '2026-04' THEN g.debit - g.credit ELSE 0 END) AS apr_expense, SUM(CASE WHEN g.period = '2026-05' THEN g.debit - g.credit ELSE 0 END) AS may_expense FROM gl_lines g JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = g.account_id WHERE g.entity_id = 'US01' AND a.type = 'Expense' AND CAST(g.account_id AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 6000 AND 6999 AND g.period IN ('2026-04', '2026-05') GROUP BY g.account_id) SELECT account_id, may_expense - apr_expense AS change_in_dollars FROM m ORDER BY change_in_dollars DESC LIMIT 1
